item.beyondsolo.citadel_key.tip: Opens a citadel a hundred floors high, standing outside the world.
item.beyondsolo.citadel_key.use: Use it to bind it to you (it is used up).
item.beyondsolo.sigil_of_dominion.tip: The seal of the Citadel's fallen lord.
item.beyondsolo.sigil_of_dominion.lore: A crown of black iron round a crimson heart. It is warm, and it is waiting.

tower.beyondsolo.tab.name: THE CRIMSON CITADEL

tower.beyondsolo.tab.sealed_use: You hold its key: use it to bind it to you.
tower.beyondsolo.tab.about: A hundred floors climb to its lord's throne, a gatekeeper on every tenth. Past the lord, the Endless Spire; in its arena, the boss rush.
tower.beyondsolo.tab.conquered: Conquered · the lord has fallen %s times
tower.beyondsolo.tab.spire_locked: Opens once the lord has fallen
tower.beyondsolo.tab.spire_new: No climb yet: how high can you go?
tower.beyondsolo.tab.rush_hint: Every boss back to back, a breather between
